portal_hypertension.title: Liver transplantation for adult presentations of MDR3 deficiency.
portal_hypertension.journal: Clinics and research in hepatology and gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.authors: Nayagam JS, Campbell SM, Chung Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：MDR3 缺乏症与终末期肝病相关，包括肝功能衰竭、门静脉高压和原发性肝癌，并且越来越多地认识到成人表现。 临床提示：我们报告了针对成人 MDR3 缺乏症的单中心肝移植 (LT) 经验。
portal_hypertension.abstract: MDR3 deficiency is associated with end-stage liver disease including liver failure, portal hypertension and primary liver cancer, with increasing recognition of adult presentations. We report our single centre experience of liver transplantation (LT) for adult presentations of MDR3 deficiency. A single centre retrospective study of patients who underwent LT for MDR3 deficiency from 2013-2024 and were first diagnosed above the age of 16 years. We identified demographic and clinical data from the electronic patient records. portal_hypertension.title: Clinically Significant Portal Hypertension in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Non-Invasive Assessment Across the Continuum.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ji P, Luo W, Cheng L
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：具有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH) 是肝细胞癌 (HCC) 手术候选资格、局部治疗安全性和全身治疗结果的关键决定因素，但其非侵入性评估仍然具有挑战性，因为 Baveno 临床提示：具有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH) 是肝细胞癌 (HCC) 手术候选资格、局部治疗安全性和全身治疗结果的关键决定因素，但其非侵入性评估
portal_hypertension.abstract: Clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) is a key determinant of surgical candidacy, locoregional therapy safety, and systemic treatment outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet its non-invasive assessment remains challenging because the Baveno criteria were derived in HCC-free cirrhosis. This review synthesises current evidence on non-invasive tests (NITs) for CSPH across the HCC care continuum, organised around three clinical scenarios: pre-operative assessment, on-treatment monitoring, and pre-immunotherapy evaluation. portal_hypertension.title: Severe constipation-associated postprandial abdominal pain in a pregnant native-liver biliary atresia survivor after Kasai portoenterostomy: A case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Alnounou A, Katwala A, Alabbas M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：评估显示肝脏合成功能得以保留，并且没有表现出临床上显着的门静脉高压。 临床提示：一名 18 岁女性，在 Kasai 门肠造口术后患有先天性胆道闭锁，并通过磁共振成像报告，在妊娠 32 周时出现慢性肝病，餐后 6 周病情恶化
portal_hypertension.abstract: An 18-year-old woman with congenital biliary atresia status post Kasai portoenterostomy and magnetic resonance imaging-reported chronic liver disease presented at 32 weeks' gestation with 6 weeks of worsening postprandial epigastric/right upper quadrant pain, nausea, and poor oral intake. Evaluation showed preserved hepatic synthetic function and no demonstrated clinically significant portal hypertension. Endoscopy excluded esophageal and gastric varices, computed tomography showed no imaging evidence of pancreatitis, biliary obstruction, or other acute intra-abdominal pathology, computed tomography angiography excluded mesenteric ischemia, and gastric emptying scintigraphy excluded gastropa...

portal_hypertension.title: A Machine Learning Model Based on Ultrasound and Serological Markers for Predicting Postoperative Stenosis of Rex Shunt Procedure in Children With Extrahepatic Portal Venous Obstruction.
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhang X, Wang H, Yang B
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：评估超声参数与血清学标志物相结合对预测肝外门静脉梗阻（EHPVO）儿童术后 Rex 分流狭窄的价值。 临床提示：开发了五种机器学习模型来预测不同随访期 Rex 分流手术后的术后狭窄，并使用接收器操作特征下的面积评估性能
portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate the value of combining ultrasound parameters with serological markers for predicting postoperative Rex shunt stenosis in children with extrahepatic portal venous obstruction (EHPVO). The training cohort and temporal validation cohort consisted of 114 and 38 children with EHPVO after Rex shunt procedure, respectively. The study variables included clinical characteristics, ultrasound parameters, and serological markers. Five machine learning models were developed to predict postoperative stenosis after the Rex shunt procedure at different follow-up periods, with performance evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC).
